clues: This is a small city in Brazil. It sits in the middle of the Mantiqueira Mountains.
The city sits high in the mountains. That height gives it a mild, soft climate.
It was founded in 1770, as farm land. That farm land is where the city stands now.
Only one paved road reaches this city. That one road, the BR-267, is the paved way in.
Each May, the city holds a farm show. Each August, it holds a feast in honour of Jesus Christ.
